description: A machine halts on input \(x\) if and only if some numerical code is a halting history for that input.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.history_exists
  (M : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Machine) (x : ℕ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.compute M x).Dom ↔
    ∃ s, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.History M x s
